newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gist-Brocades unit chief Van Rappart resigns.
newsitem.headline: Gist-Brocades unit chief Van Rappart resigns.

text.p: Dutch biochemicals and food group Gist-Brocades NV said on Thursday Rene van Rappard, President and Chief Executive Officer of the unit Gist-Brocades/Bio-Intermediar Intl, would resign on July 1.
"Van Rappard declared his job is done," Gist-Brocades said in a statement.
Van Rappard joined Bio-Intermediar at the beginning of 1993 and sold the company to Gist-Brocades in August of last year.
"Bio-Intermediar will be the core of Gist-Brocades' biopharmaceutical business," Gist said in a statement.
Gist-Brocades/Bio-Intermediar Intl is a biotechnology group of companies with facilities in Groningen (the Netherlands) and Montreal (Canada).
It is one of the two leading contract manufacturers of biopharmaceuticals in the world and employs about 120 people, a spokesman said.
Parent company Gist-Brocades has a net turnover of more than 2.0 billion guilders, of which 40 percent is in pharmaceutical intermediates and bulk actives.
